title: Triage assessment
description: The low-confidence fallback's whole output: an assessment in prose, a category, and either the name of a skill or a reason to escalate. There is no numeric property anywhere in this schema and no field a figure could enter through, so 'triage guessed a number' is not a failure mode available to it - the cases that reach here are unusual entity structures, hybrid instruments and incoherent client data, which are exactly the cases where a made-up figure would be most plausible and most damaging. It cannot start work either: naming a skill is a suggestion recorded for a person, never a dispatch.

category.description: What kind of not-fitting this is. Categorical so that the same situation is named the same way twice and the analytics can count them.

assessment.description: What the orchestrator was looking at and why nothing routed, in prose a person reads. It states a problem; it never states a value.

suggested_skill.description: A name from the Skill Index, if one now looks right. Checked against the index before it is recorded: a name that did not resolve into this engagement's scope is dropped and the assessment escalates instead, because a suggestion nobody can act on is worse than none.

escalation_reason.description: Why this needs a person. Becomes the subject of the review item.
